newsitem.title: UK: Heseltine favourite to succeed UK's Major.
newsitem.headline: Heseltine favourite to succeed UK's Major.

text.p: Deputy prime minister Michael Heseltine is favourite to take over from Prime Minister John Major as leader of the Conservatives if the ruling party loses the next election, bookmakers William Hill said on Friday.

William Hill said it made Heseltine 11-4 favourite to take over. Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke, Health Secretary Stephen Dorrell and Defence Secretary Michael Portillo are joint second favourites at 4-1.
The Labour party are 2-5 favourites to win the election, due in the next seven months, with the Conservatives 7-4.

"I think this means that our punters forsee a situation in which John Major loses the election and steps down, allowing Heseltine in as a short-term leader while the party reorganises," said William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe.
